notes.title: The release date is being shifted.
notes.content:
I have to inform you that unfortunately the game will not be able to be released in November.
 The main reason is that I did not have time to finish the game, but there are other factors (I will not cover them). 
The release date is shifted by about 1 year (~ **.09.2025).
I am very sorry.

notes.title: The menu with settings is almost ready.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5OMKG0_reX0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
This is the menu that is emerging now :)
The game is quite demanding, with high system requirements. To test the functionality on your computer, closer to the release, a demo version will be available. The release is scheduled for November 2024, but I may almost miss it. I will try to do it on time.

notes.title: Graphics update.
notes.content:
With the advent of more powerful game-building equipment, I reworked EVERYTHING!
I replaced all the graphics, from the word - completely.🙊
The previous screenshots and videos have gone into history.

notes.title: Без названия
notes.content:
Hi all! 
I finished hospital treatment 💉, I'm transferring to a day hospital! 
I'm fine! Finally, development has moved off the ground!

notes.title: Paused game development!
notes.content:
Friends, hello everyone! 
Forced to pause the game due to my illness (leukemia). Add the game to your wishlist. I'll get better and do everything!

notes.title: Join the community
notes.content: To discuss development issues, join the community.

notes.title: Release Demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Yesterday in Steam, a demo version of the game became available.
It is difficult to call it a full-fledged demo version, because. the location is not fully built up, and the ducks are still without intelligence, but for trying on your computer, it will do. To be honest, the demo was released to participate in the February festival - "Games to be" (21.02 - 28.02).

notes.title: This is the first long-awaited news!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
The work on the character controller is finished - these are animation and control scripts. 
The first weapon in the game was the Saiga 12, a self-loading rifle.
For shooting are used: hunting cartridges of 12 caliber - these are shot, buckshot and bullets.
